basic_info.description: Welcome to this beautifully renovated 4-bedroom home, perfectly situated in the vibrant and walkable Mission District. Thoughtfully updated with a brand-new kitchen and bathrooms, this home also features gleaming hardwood floors and a marble-surround fireplace, combining modern elegance with timeless charm. The upper level offers two bedrooms, two baths, a living room, and a family room. Step outside to a tranquil garden oasis with a Koi pond, plunge pool, and fruit trees, including avocado and apple, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The lower level, though unwarranted, includes two additional bedrooms, a sitting room, an office, and a bath, plus ample storage, a laundry room, and one-car interior parking. An additional exterior parking space completes the home's practicality.  Located in the heart of the Mission District, this home is surrounded by a dynamic blend of culture, art, and music. Known for its vibrant murals, eclectic galleries, and lively community events, the area exudes creative energy. With steps to cozy coffee shops and acclaimed dining like Penny Roma and Flour + Water, and nightlife gems like True Laurel, you'll experience the neighborhood's unique spirit and rich heritage. Don't miss this rare opportunity to make it yours!
